XYZ Corporation shows mixed financial health indicators. On the positive side, the company has achieved significant top-line growth, with revenue increasing by 20% from $500 million to $600 million. However, this growth has been accompanied by a disproportionate rise in operating costs, which jumped by approximately 33% from $300 million to $400 million. Consequently, the operating margin has remained stagnant, indicating that the company is not becoming more efficient in converting revenue into operating profit. Furthermore, the increase in the debt-to-equity ratio from 0.5 to 0.8 suggests a higher level of financial leverage and increased risk, as the company is relying more on debt financing relative to equity.

The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.
